selection.overlap: None with prior selected rounds2–5 or central authored-source entries.
selection.retrieval: Retained permitted snapshots only, hashes rechecked; no network/refetch.

helper_extent_policy: All selected-file definitions read; explicit needed support extents with pending complements. Go reflect implementation unreviewed. No additional peer-test credit for helpers.
coverage_policy: Frozen source/test spans and exact expected bytes only, no new pass claim. Matching values not copy/lifetime/pointer proof; absence statements bounded to inspected fixtures.

restrictions.unreviewed_support: Support complements explicit; diagnostic formatting/transitive utilities outside necessary extents unreviewed. Go reflect implementation not retained/read: typeof helper calls TypeOf(x).String() and compares type names; excluded all three predicates, no reflect implementation claim.
restrictions.unselected: All other peer files/directories outside selection unreviewed by round6.
